newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA sees net profit rising to $4.3 bln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA sees net profit rising to $4.3 bln in 1996.

text.p: Venezuela's state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) expects to make a net profit of $4.3 billion in 1996, up from $3.1 billion last year, a top company official said Friday.
"It has been an excellent year. Profits will be about $4.3 billion this year," said the official, who asked not to be named.
Higher than expected oil prices and lower costs were the main reasons for improved revenues, he said. The official also acknowledged that output had been raised but would not give a specific amount.

Venezuela has an Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) quota of 2.359 million barrels per day (bpd). Although some industry sources say PDVSA is producing about 700,000 bpd above this level while others see Venezuela pumping as much as 3.15 million bpd.
